name: Tea Counter
author: Michael Davies
description: Track cups of tea and caffeine load, with week/month/year history.

barWidget.description: One-tap tea logging with presets, a daily caffeine total, and week/month/year history.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the widget shows in the bar before you open it.

schema.label: Day rolls over at (hour)
schema.description: A cup logged before this hour counts toward the previous day. 4 means a 2am cup belongs to last night.

schema.label: Caffeine per full cup (mg)
schema.description: Milligrams in one full cup of black tea. Green is 60% of this, herbal 0%, decaf 4%, and size scales it linearly.
